//: Audited HTML sinks in js/ whose markup is NOT a source constant — read by
Key: <file>::<receiver source>.<sink> (no line numbers). `count` is how many
sites share the key. `reason` says why every dynamic part is ours, never
player text. A new site should use Dom.el()/textContent or escape, not a row.
`rhs` is the sorted short sha256s of each site's whitespace-collapsed HTML expression;
a changed expression fails as CHANGED: re-audit it, then `html-sink-lint.mjs --rehash`.

js/garage/arrival.js::map.innerHTML.reason: GARAGE ANGLE plan of the bay: angleMap(value.angle, value.shots) where value is settings(), which only returns an ANGLES member for angle and CAMS keys for shots; every other part is a number from CAMS / the bay constants formatted with toFixed, a shot index, or a literal.

js/game.js::sum.innerHTML.reason: HUD fold summary: hudProfile / hudMetricsLayout are validated against HUD_PROFILES / HUD_MET_LAYOUTS at load and in the G setters; every other part is a literal.

js/perf/metrics-overlay.js::sum.innerHTM.reason: METRICS fold summary: page() is readPage(), which returns only a PAGES member (store) or a /(gov|car|phys|log)/ query match.

js/perf/renderer-picker.js::sum.innerHTM.reason: RENDERER fold summary: backendLabel() of readBackend() (webgl2|webgpu|three, anything else reset to webgl2) and liveBackend() (constants).

js/ui/aria-state.js::el.innerHTML.reason: paintOnOff re-wraps a button's textContent; wrapOnOff ESCAPES & < > " ' before inserting its own spans (the 2026-09-24 stored-XSS fix — custom driver names reach these buttons).

js/ui/dom.js::target.innerHTML.reason: Dom.paintFold: [kind, label] pairs are the callers' constants or validated enums (audio/panel.js, input/steer-tuning.js) — never user text. Keep it that way: a caller with free text must use Dom.el().

js/ui/loading-screen.js::$(\"ld-flag\")..reason: Flags.svg(country): emits only a built-in RECIPES flag keyed by a known code (unknown input falls back to "xx"); the input never reaches the markup as text.

js/ui/select-screen.js::fl.innerHTML.reason: Flags.svg(t.country) — see loading-screen: the markup is a built-in recipe, not the input.

js/ui/select-screen.js::flagEl.innerHTML.reason: Flags.svg(t.country) — see loading-screen: the markup is a built-in recipe, not the input.

js/ui/select-screen.js::drsList.innerHTM.reason: Circuit DRS zones from js/circuits/ data (code, not player input); every interpolation is a Math.round() number or the zone index.

js/ui/select-screen.js::list.innerHTML.reason: Circuit corner list from TrackMaps: c.n is a number, the class comes from the TDC_CLS map, and lbl is TrackMaps' corner class (HAIRPIN/SLOW/MEDIUM/FAST) — circuit data, not player input.
